title: Design Workflow Reconstruction Schema (v0.1, Pilot)
description: Schema for reverse-constructing design-workflow data from public zcool.com.cn brand design case pages. Pilot-quality: field set is stable but not yet validated at scale.

evidence_type.description: explicit: page body text explicitly describes the step/decision. visual_explicit: the image itself unambiguously shows the stage (e.g. a color swatch sheet, logo sketch grid, type spec sheet). inferred: only derivable from surrounding context/order, not stated. unknown: cannot be determined. `inferred` must never be treated as a confirmed fact downstream.

workflow_completeness.description: complete: brief through final application all present with explicit or visual_explicit evidence and recoverable order. substantial: most mid-pipeline stages present (e.g. strategy + at least one exploration/selection stage + at least one output stage) but brief or guidelines may be missing. partial: only a few stages recoverable, mostly single-stage evidence, order largely unrecoverable. showcase_only: only final outputs/mockups present, no process evidence of any kind. unusable: page is not a real single-project design case (e.g. multi-project collection, generic article) or content is too degraded to analyze.

case.description: Section A — case-level fields, one object per pilot case.

source_publish_date.description: As stated on page, often relative (e.g. '1年前'); record raw string, do not compute an absolute date that the page did not provide.

design_category.description: e.g. brand_full_case, brand_full_case_packaging, logo_showcase, logo_collection, educational_article.

case_summary.description: 1-3 sentence factual summary; must not include invented details beyond what the page states.

source_quality.description: Pilot note: as of 2026-08-05 all 8 candidate pages returned text_ok_images_blocked via WebFetch — real image bytes were not retrievable (placeholder images only), see logs/access_log.md.

copyright_or_reuse_notes.description: Must state platform, author, and that content is zcool designer IP, not Curify-owned.

step.description: Section B — one workflow step. A case has 0..N steps.

step_id.description: Unique within its case, e.g. case_006_step_03.

stage_name.description: Human-readable label, may be the page's own section heading if present.

design_operation.description: What the designer did in this step, stated or visually evident.

candidate_outputs.description: asset_id references to candidate/alternative outputs, if shown.

selected_output.description: asset_id of the chosen candidate, if stated or visually marked.

next_step_dependencies.description: step_id references this step feeds into.

evidence_text.description: Verbatim or closely-paraphrased quote from page body supporting this step. Required when evidence_type is explicit.

order_basis.description: Which evidence tier (per CLEANING_RULES_V0.1.md section 7) established step_order.

asset.description: Section C — one visual/media asset referenced by a case.

local_path.description: Must be null unless the file was actually downloaded in this session. Never fabricate a path.

source_position.description: 1-indexed position of the asset in the page's original image sequence.

detected_content.description: What the asset appears to show. If image bytes were not retrievable (per source_quality), this must be null or explicitly 'unknown - image not retrieved', never guessed from caption alone.

has_watermark.description: boolean if verified visually; string 'unknown' if image bytes unavailable.

long_image_panel.description: Optional sub-structure for section on long-image splitting (see CLEANING_RULES_V0.1.md section 3). Not populated in this pilot (no images were downloaded), defined for forward compatibility.
